Morning! Could you handle the following:
1. write a one-line apology I can paste to the customer
2. quick one before my next meeting — Refund order ORD-9934 in full — it's just the $36.50 coffee mug
3. pull up the orders for j.okafor@example.com and tell me how many are delivered
4. check whether ORD-9934 has already been refunded

function.description: End the task with a short summary of what you did (or deliberately did not do) and why.
